text: The first dragon spawns at 5:00, and the next one 5 minutes after a dragon dies. After a team's fourth dragon, the Elder Dragon spawns instead, with a 6-minute respawn.
Void Grubs spawn once, at 8:00, and don't respawn.
source: Riot: Patch 25.09 notes (no change since, per the wiki's Voidgrub camp history)

text: The Rift Herald spawns once, at 15:00, and leaves at 19:45 (19:55 if it's in a fight).
source: Riot: Patch 25.09 notes (spawn); LoL Wiki: Rift Herald (despawn)

text: Atakhan has been removed from the game.
Wolves, Blue Sentinel, Red Brambleback and Raptors spawn at 0:55; Krugs and Gromp at 1:07; the Scuttle Crabs at 2:55.

Top's role quest reward: Unleashed Teleport as a bonus summoner spell (390-second cooldown); if Teleport is already taken, it shields for 35% of maximum health for 10 seconds after the channel and its cooldown drops by 30 seconds. Also 600 experience, 11% bonus experience, 80 bonus experience per takedown, and a level cap of 20.
source: LoL Wiki: Role Quests (Riot: Patch 26.19 notes for the cooldown)

text: Jungle's role quest reward: Primal Smite, 10 bonus gold and 10 bonus experience per jungle camp, and 4% movement speed in the jungle or river (8% out of combat).
Mid's role quest reward: 8% bonus AD and 8% bonus AP, and Tier 2 boots upgrade to exclusive Tier 3 boots for free.
Bot's role quest reward: 300 gold, 2 bonus gold per minion, 40 bonus gold per champion takedown, and boots move to the role quest slot.
Support's role quest reward: Runic Compass upgrades to Bounty of Worlds, and Control Wards cost 40 gold.
